Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (pilot scope)

Thanks Jordan — good conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on responsibilities and target close. I’ve attached a first-pass MAP workbook (Pilot-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and a Redwood SOW template for reference.

High-level scope (pilot):
- Ingest 1TB historical logs + streaming enrichment to Redwood API
- Up to 5k daily inference requests; 99th p95 latency target for user flows
- Security: VPC peering + KMS integration for keys

Proposed milestones and target dates:
- Milestone A: Requirements & legal checklist complete — target 2027-05-20 — owner: PilotData (Jordan / Priya)
- Milestone B: Security review & technical PoC — target 2027-06-03 — owner: PilotData security + Redwood infra (Sergio, Marcus)
- Milestone C: Pilot deploy & smoke tests — target 2027-06-14 — owner: Redwood (Ava, Marcus)
- Milestone D: Success review & contract signature (pilot → production) — target 2027-06-24 — owner: Jordan / Redwood sales

Initial RACI (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Jordan Ellis (PilotData) — A
- Security owner: Samir Rao (PilotData) — R
- Legal owner: Priya Kaur (PilotData) — C
- Engineering lead: Marcus Lin (Redwood) — R

Open dependencies we flagged on the call:
- PilotData to grant test dataset access and IP allowlist for VPC peering
- Mutual NDA redlines (legal) — Priya to confirm timeline
- Account-level SSO provisioning (IdP) — PilotData IT to confirm

Asks / next steps:
1) Jordan/Priya: confirm economic buyer, legal owner, security owner and target dates above (reply-all with any edits)
2) PilotData: upload the test dataset access details to the Drive link I shared; note any compliance artifacts we should expect to review
3) Internal: Sergio + Marcus — can you review the PoC milestone tasks in the attached MAP and flag any missing infra work by EOD Wednesday (2027-05-12)?

If everyone is aligned I’ll update the MAP workbook and share a final link (and we can push to an official HubSpot MAP).

Thanks again — looking forward to progressing.
